meta_description_en: Chris Clayton reviews Microdrive management, recovery, and backup utilities for the ZX Spectrum, including Micromate, M/Drive Doctor, RAMDOS, and IMBOS.
meta_description_ru: Крис Клейтон делает обзор утилит управления, восстановления и бэкапа для ZX Microdrive: Micromate, M/Drive Doctor, RAMDOS, IMBOS и др.
body_en_plain:
MICRODRIVE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS,
 CHRIS CLAYTON- A personal view
 of  programs which  assist and
 enhance  the operation  of the
 microdrive,  including a  look
 at some of the latest on offer
 ------------------------------
Regular users of microdrives can
benefit greatly by having one or
more of the microdrive manage-
ment programs that are available
to assist them. There is a great
variety of facilities available
on the different programs.

Although an entirely satisfact-
ory system of classification is
not possible they seem to fall
broadly into the following three
categories, though in several
cases a program, or suite of
programs, will combine features
of several categories:



1. BOOTING .....

Essentially this type of program
enables you to do what you can
already do with microdrives but
more quickly and efficiently,
such as loading, saving and
erasing with a few key presses
or even just one instead of the
normal long-winded syntax.

2. DOCTORING .....

These programs examine, modify
and repair faulty files so that,
if successful, files which
produced the "File not found"
report can be loaded.

3. PROGRAMMING ....

Utilities which aid programming
and enable a variety of effects
to be achieved easily.An example
of the first type is CHEZRON'S
CATLOADER. Some programs may be
single-purpose such as ZAP from
OUTLET which I have found quite
useful, enabling me to go off to
make a drink while a large num-
ber of unwanted files are erased
automatically from a cartridge.

Soon after I acquired my first
microdrive I came across MICRO-
DRIVE CONTROLLER by SD MICRO-
SYSTEMS. Basically this provided
a catalogue of a cartridge with
each program allocated with a
letter, A,B,C etc. enabling them
to be loaded, saved, erased with
a single key press. At first the
facility I found most useful was
an automatic repeat format but
this was soon made obsolete by
the M/DRIVE DOCTOR format
facility described below. SD,who
produced a number of useful
Spectrum business programs, like
a MAILING LIST/LABEL PRINTER,did
not reply to my last letter so
may no longer be in business.
However,details of a similar en-
hanced program called MICRODRIVE

MANAGER were sent to me from 7,
CURLEW DRIVE, HYTHE at the start
of 1988. This has extra features
such as backing-up cartridges,
renaming files and multiple cop-
ies of files for quick loading.

M/DRIVE DOCTOR by PIPEQ was for
me the big break-through, and,
although this program appears
not to be on sale now, other
programs are appearing with
similar features. M/DRIVE DOCTOR
among its many features formats
my cartridges to around 100K,
prints a detailed catalogue(type
of file,start addresses,auto-run
lines, etc.) clones cartridges,
lists all the sectors a named
file occupies, produces multiple
copies on the same cartridge,
identifies faulty sectors,

attempts to repair faulty files,
renames files and so on.I used
to find particularly useful the
facility to print out on screen
or paper the ASCII contents of a
corrupted file which would not
reload into my wordprocessor.

The beauty of M/DRIVE DOCTOR for
someone like me is that except
for the more complicated sector
editor facility,it is simplicity
itself to use.The whole utility,
saved several times on the same
cartridge, loads very quickly.In
most cases little more is then
required than entering * CAT, or
* LLIST, or *READ, or * CHAR$ or
*RESTORE and so on. For example,
* MOVE transfers everything from
one cartridge to another (with
two drives).

M/DRIVE DOCTOR should not be
confused with M-DOC from SEVEN
STARS PUBLISHING, 34 SQUIRREL
RISE, MARLOW, BUCKS. who also
produce the excellent QUALITAS
print utilities for TASWORD 2
and TASWORD 3. M-DOC is for
repairing and editing faulty
sectors/files, including BASIC.
I understand it requires some
effort. One reviewer wrote "this
is not a program for the
impatient" so clearly it is not
a program for me! However, from
my experince with other programs
from SEVEN STARS and their will-
ingness to help I am confident
that some microdrivers will find
it very useful.

RAMDOS MICRODRIVE MANAGEMENT AND
RECOVERY SOFTWARE from ROYBOT,
45 HULLBRIDGE ROAD, RAYLEIGH,
ESSEX, has many similar features
to M/DRIVE DOCTOR but operates
quite differently. It is menu-
driven and I find it just a
little more difficult to use,
requiring some switching around
of cartridges and working out
which item on the menu is
needed. However,it has a compre-
hensive, reasonably clear and
well-produced handbook. I am
sure it is quite easy to master
and would have used it more if I
had not also had M/DRIVE DOCTOR
to rely on. Additional features
of interest are the ability to
save files or dump whole
cartridges to tape (OUTLET for

example)although they have to be
loaded back via RAMDOS; and the
facility to make suspect areas
of a cartridge'busy'so that they
will not be used, hence making
the cartridge more reliable.
Comprehensive information can be
obtained on the state of cart-
ridges and files. RAMDOS produce
a number of other programs of
interest, including MICRODRIVE
OPERATING SYSTEM.

TRANSFORM,of 24 WEST OAK,BECKEN-
HAM, KENT also provide SUPADRIVE
that formats cartridges to about
100k, retrieves corrupted files
and prints a full catalogue.

My latest and probably now most
useful acquisition is MICROMATE
from LERM of 11 BEACONSFIELD

CLOSE, WHITLEY BAY. It is the
most comprehensive package,
having a mixture of the facil-
ities available in some of the
above programs. In addition to
the cartridge a cassette is
supplied with backups of some of
the cartridge programs, plus
"RUN", a very simple single key
press BOOT utility, but for
BASIC programs only (which of
course includes machine code
programs with a BASIC loader).
There is a very detailed hand-
book which besides giving oper-
ating instructions for the
various parts of MICROMATE also
has a lot of technical informat-
ion on how the microdrive works
which is likely to be of inter-
est to many OUTLET subscribers.

Menu-driven, MICROMATE has:

1. FULL CAT giving detailed
information including sectors
used and can save the inform-
ation for use with a printer,
plus altering of auto-run lines,
and erase.

2. TOOLKIT for reconditioning
cartridges, repairing sectors,
making bad ones unusable,
multiple erase. The way in which
very detailed information about
the state of a cartridge is
provided on screen is very
impressive, and to me quite
intriguing. I am almost looking
forward to a "File not found"
report so I can try it out
properly.

3. BACKUP for 1 or 2 drives,
copies files, clones cartridges,
re-names files,checks errors and
so on. It has a very impressive
format facility, allowing a
choice of 10 different settings
ranging from around 85k to 104k.
(Higher capacity is paid for by
lower reliability but I have not
found my 100k cartridges from
M/DRIVE DOCTOR unreliable in
practice).

4. TAPER is already proving very
useful, as it copies files from
cartridge to tape either under
manual control or automatically
with the recorder left on. The
latter is wasteful of cassette
tape but a great saving in time
and patience ! A whole cartridge


can be dumped or files can be
selected in advance, and they
load back independently of
MICROMATE, unlike RAMDOS. I am
now dumping OUTLET, having first
selected out unwanted files,
thus freeing valuable cartridges
for future OUTLET use , making
it even better value for money!

5. MINITAPE 8 copies from tape
to drive, but not protected
programs.

Ease of use? Well, so far,I have
found MICROMATE quite easy, with
helpful on-screen prompts. The
handbook could be off-putting at
first but it does indicate what
is essential reading and what is
optional. I have been surprised

at how well I have managed those
functions I have tried. After a
couple of early mistakes every-
thing has worked well.

IMBOS from COMPANION of 193
BRAMPTON ROAD, CARLISLE, CUMBRIA
is something rather different to
the above programs. [V.2 of
IMBOS is now available from
KOBRAHSOFT and we have ordered a
copy for review- Brian]It does
have 10 microdrive management
commands, so that programs can
be loaded, saved, erased, etc.
by simple commands such as RUN
"name", OUT! "name", * ERASE
"name" (a more consistent syntax
would have been even simpler).
LIST CAT produces a catalogue in
which any protected files (ie.

using CHR$ 0) are listed and
indicated.But IMBOS is much more
than this. It fits better under
category 3: PROGRAMMING AID,
containing a very large number
of commands to assist programm-
ing producing impressive sound,
graphics, colour, print, font,
scrolling, monitoring and other
effects.I don't do any programm-
ing so I neither understand nor
have much use for a large part
of the package (some of which
reminds me of SUPERCODE III) but
I know the effects are impress-
ive because a 10 minute demon-
stration program is provided.
There is a lot in it which I
think might be valuable to me if
I can learn what it is all
about. The handbook is written

for someone much more knowledg-
able than I am.Reviews have been
very enthusiastic and from comm-
ents published in OUTLET about
various OUTLET routines, IMBOS
would be 'right up the street'
of many subscribers, so perhaps
we may get some tips from them
eventually. IMBOS actually uses
Interface 1 but can work without
drives.COMPANION also supply EX-
BASIC, an extended version which
does not require Interface 1.

So, which would I recommend? It
depends on your individual needs
of course.All of them are useful
especially,I suspect, to someone
like me with very limited know-
ledge, time and patience. Prices
range from about seven to fif-
teen pounds (CATLOADER is even

cheaper) so I think they are all
good value especially those that
enable you to increase the cap-
acity of cartridges. If M/DRIVE
DOCTOR was available it would
still be high on my list for
sheer simplicity.If I could only
have ONE of the programs I would
now go for LERM's MICROMATE.

               - Chris Clayton
--------------------------------
Nice one, Chris! You've covered
the lot there! If anyone else
would like to send in an article
on any utilities they have (even
if already reviewed in OUTLET)
don't hesitate! ANY format, same
as OUTLETTERS and 1 OR 2 SCREEN$
can be sent too which I'll MERGE
in as required. - Brian.
body_en:
### MICRODRIVE MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS
**by Chris Clayton**

*A personal view of programs which assist and enhance the operation of the microdrive, including a look at some of the latest on offer.*

Regular users of microdrives can benefit greatly by having one or more of the microdrive management programs that are available to assist them. There is a great variety of facilities available on the different programs.

Although an entirely satisfactory system of classification is not possible, they seem to fall broadly into the following three categories, though in several cases a program, or suite of programs, will combine features of several categories:

#### 1. BOOTING
Essentially this type of program enables you to do what you can already do with microdrives but more quickly and efficiently, such as loading, saving and erasing with a few key presses or even just one instead of the normal long-winded syntax.

#### 2. DOCTORING
These programs examine, modify and repair faulty files so that, if successful, files which produced the "File not found" report can be loaded.

#### 3. PROGRAMMING
Utilities which aid programming and enable a variety of effects to be achieved easily.

An example of the first type is Chezron's CATLOADER. Some programs may be single-purpose such as ZAP from OUTLET, which I have found quite useful, enabling me to go off to make a drink while a large number of unwanted files are erased automatically from a cartridge.

Soon after I acquired my first microdrive I came across MICRODRIVE CONTROLLER by SD Microsystems. Basically this provided a catalogue of a cartridge with each program allocated a letter (A, B, C, etc.), enabling them to be loaded, saved, or erased with a single key press. At first the facility I found most useful was an automatic repeat format, but this was soon made obsolete by the M/DRIVE DOCTOR format facility described below. SD, who produced a number of useful Spectrum business programs, like a MAILING LIST/LABEL PRINTER, did not reply to my last letter, so may no longer be in business. However, details of a similar enhanced program called MICRODRIVE MANAGER were sent to me from 7, Curlew Drive, Hythe at the start of 1988. This has extra features such as backing-up cartridges, renaming files and multiple copies of files for quick loading.

M/DRIVE DOCTOR by Pipeq was for me the big break-through, and, although this program appears not to be on sale now, other programs are appearing with similar features. M/DRIVE DOCTOR among its many features formats my cartridges to around 100K, prints a detailed catalogue (type of file, start addresses, auto-run lines, etc.), clones cartridges, lists all the sectors a named file occupies, produces multiple copies on the same cartridge, identifies faulty sectors, attempts to repair faulty files, renames files and so on. I used to find particularly useful the facility to print out on screen or paper the ASCII contents of a corrupted file which would not reload into my wordprocessor.

The beauty of M/DRIVE DOCTOR for someone like me is that, except for the more complicated sector editor facility, it is simplicity itself to use. The whole utility, saved several times on the same cartridge, loads very quickly. In most cases little more is then required than entering `* CAT`, or `* LLIST`, or `* READ`, or `* CHAR$` or `* RESTORE` and so on. For example, `* MOVE` transfers everything from one cartridge to another (with two drives).

M/DRIVE DOCTOR should not be confused with M-DOC from Seven Stars Publishing, 34 Squirrel Rise, Marlow, Bucks., who also produce the excellent QUALITAS print utilities for Tasword 2 and Tasword 3. M-DOC is for repairing and editing faulty sectors/files, including BASIC. I understand it requires some effort. One reviewer wrote "this is not a program for the impatient", so clearly it is not a program for me! However, from my experience with other programs from Seven Stars and their willingness to help, I am confident that some microdrivers will find it very useful.

RAMDOS MICRODRIVE MANAGEMENT AND RECOVERY SOFTWARE from Roybot, 45 Hullbridge Road, Rayleigh, Essex, has many similar features to M/DRIVE DOCTOR but operates quite differently. It is menu-driven and I find it just a little more difficult to use, requiring some switching around of cartridges and working out which item on the menu is needed. However, it has a comprehensive, reasonably clear and well-produced handbook. I am sure it is quite easy to master and would have used it more if I had not also had M/DRIVE DOCTOR to rely on. Additional features of interest are the ability to save files or dump whole cartridges to tape (OUTLET for example), although they have to be loaded back via RAMDOS; and the facility to make suspect areas of a cartridge 'busy' so that they will not be used, hence making the cartridge more reliable. Comprehensive information can be obtained on the state of cartridges and files. RAMDOS produce a number of other programs of interest, including MICRODRIVE OPERATING SYSTEM.

Transform, of 24 West Oak, Beckenham, Kent, also provide SUPADRIVE that formats cartridges to about 100k, retrieves corrupted files and prints a full catalogue.

My latest and probably now most useful acquisition is MICROMATE from LERM of 11 Beaconsfield Close, Whitley Bay. It is the most comprehensive package, having a mixture of the facilities available in some of the above programs. In addition to the cartridge, a cassette is supplied with backups of some of the cartridge programs, plus "RUN", a very simple single key press BOOT utility, but for BASIC programs only (which of course includes machine code programs with a BASIC loader). There is a very detailed handbook which, besides giving operating instructions for the various parts of MICROMATE, also has a lot of technical information on how the microdrive works, which is likely to be of interest to many OUTLET subscribers.

Menu-driven, MICROMATE has:

1. **FULL CAT** — giving detailed information including sectors used, and can save the information for use with a printer, plus altering of auto-run lines, and erase.
2. **TOOLKIT** — for reconditioning cartridges, repairing sectors, making bad ones unusable, and multiple erase. The way in which very detailed information about the state of a cartridge is provided on screen is very impressive, and to me quite intriguing. I am almost looking forward to a "File not found" report so I can try it out properly.
3. **BACKUP** — for 1 or 2 drives, copies files, clones cartridges, renames files, checks errors and so on. It has a very impressive format facility, allowing a choice of 10 different settings ranging from around 85k to 104k. (Higher capacity is paid for by lower reliability, but I have not found my 100k cartridges from M/DRIVE DOCTOR unreliable in practice).
4. **TAPER** — is already proving very useful, as it copies files from cartridge to tape either under manual control or automatically with the recorder left on. The latter is wasteful of cassette tape but a great saving in time and patience! A whole cartridge can be dumped or files can be selected in advance, and they load back independently of MICROMATE, unlike RAMDOS. I am now dumping OUTLET, having first selected out unwanted files, thus freeing valuable cartridges for future OUTLET use, making it even better value for money!
5. **MINITAPE 8** — copies from tape to drive, but not protected programs.

Ease of use? Well, so far, I have found MICROMATE quite easy, with helpful on-screen prompts. The handbook could be off-putting at first, but it does indicate what is essential reading and what is optional. I have been surprised at how well I have managed those functions I have tried. After a couple of early mistakes everything has worked well.

IMBOS from Companion of 193 Brampton Road, Carlisle, Cumbria, is something rather different to the above programs. *(V.2 of IMBOS is now available from Kobrahsoft and we have ordered a copy for review — Brian)*. It does have 10 microdrive management commands, so that programs can be loaded, saved, erased, etc. by simple commands such as `RUN "name"`, `OUT! "name"`, `* ERASE "name"` (a more consistent syntax would have been even simpler). `LIST CAT` produces a catalogue in which any protected files (i.e. using `CHR$ 0`) are listed and indicated. But IMBOS is much more than this. It fits better under category 3: PROGRAMMING AID, containing a very large number of commands to assist programming, producing impressive sound, graphics, colour, print, font, scrolling, monitoring and other effects. I don't do any programming, so I neither understand nor have much use for a large part of the package (some of which reminds me of SUPERCODE III), but I know the effects are impressive because a 10-minute demonstration program is provided. There is a lot in it which I think might be valuable to me if I can learn what it is all about. The handbook is written for someone much more knowledgeable than I am. Reviews have been very enthusiastic and, from comments published in OUTLET about various OUTLET routines, IMBOS would be 'right up the street' of many subscribers, so perhaps we may get some tips from them eventually. IMBOS actually uses Interface 1 but can work without drives. Companion also supply EX-BASIC, an extended version which does not require Interface 1.

So, which would I recommend? It depends on your individual needs, of course. All of them are useful, especially, I suspect, to someone like me with very limited knowledge, time and patience. Prices range from about seven to fifteen pounds (CATLOADER is even cheaper), so I think they are all good value, especially those that enable you to increase the capacity of cartridges. If M/DRIVE DOCTOR was available it would still be high on my list for sheer simplicity. If I could only have ONE of the programs, I would now go for LERM's MICROMATE.

*— Chris Clayton*

---

*Nice one, Chris! You've covered the lot there! If anyone else would like to send in an article on any utilities they have (even if already reviewed in OUTLET) don't hesitate! ANY format, same as OUTLETTERS and 1 OR 2 SCREEN$ can be sent too which I'll MERGE in as required. — Brian.*
body_ru:
### СИСТЕМЫ УПРАВЛЕНИЯ MICRODRIVE
**Крис Клейтон**

*Личный взгляд на программы, облегчающие и улучшающие работу с микродрайвом, включая обзор некоторых новинок на рынке.*

Постоянные пользователи Microdrive могут извлечь огромную пользу, имея под рукой одну или несколько специализированных утилит управления. Разнообразие возможностей в различных программах действительно впечатляет.

Хотя абсолютно строгая классификация вряд ли возможна, в целом их можно разделить на три основные категории (хотя зачастую программа или комплекс программ совмещают черты нескольких из них):

#### 1. ЗАГРУЗЧИКИ (BOOTING)
По сути, программы этого типа позволяют делать то же самое, что вы уже привыкли делать с микродрайвами, но быстрее и удобнее — например, загружать, сохранять и стирать файлы парой нажатий клавиш (или даже одним) вместо длинного и громоздкого стандартного синтаксиса.

#### 2. «ДОКТОРА» (DOCTORING)
Эти программы проверяют, модифицируют и восстанавливают поврежденные файлы, чтобы файлы, выдававшие ошибку «File not found», снова могли нормально загрузиться.

#### 3. ПОМОЩНИКИ ПРОГРАММИСТА (PROGRAMMING)
Утилиты, помогающие при создании программ и позволяющие без труда реализовывать различные эффекты.

Примером первой категории служит CATLOADER от Chezron. Некоторые программы могут быть узкоспециализированными, как, например, ZAP из журнала OUTLET. Она оказалась для меня очень полезной, позволяя отойти и налить себе чаю, пока с картриджа автоматически удаляется куча ненужных файлов.

Вскоре после покупки своего первого микродрайва я наткнулся на программу MICRODRIVE CONTROLLER от SD Microsystems. В сущности, она выводила каталог картриджа, где каждой программе присваивалась буква (A, B, C и т.д.), позволяя загружать, сохранять или удалять их нажатием одной клавиши. Сначала самой ценной функцией мне показалось автоматическое повторное форматирование, но вскоре она устарела благодаря возможностям форматирования в M/DRIVE DOCTOR (о которой ниже). Компания SD, выпустившая ряд полезных бизнес-программ для Спектрума вроде MAILING LIST/LABEL PRINTER, не ответила на мое последнее письмо, так что, возможно, они уже закрылись. Впрочем, в начале 1988 года мне прислали описание похожей улучшенной программы MICRODRIVE MANAGER из 7, Curlew Drive, Hythe. В ней есть дополнительные функции: резервное копирование картриджей, переименование файлов и создание нескольких копий файла для ускорения загрузки.

M/DRIVE DOCTOR от Pipeq стал для меня настоящим прорывом. И хотя эта программа сейчас, судя по всему, снята с продажи, на рынке появляются аналогичные решения. M/DRIVE DOCTOR форматирует картриджи примерно до 100 КБ, печатает подробный каталог (тип файла, стартовые адреса, строки автозапуска и т.д.), клонирует картриджи, выводит список всех секторов, занимаемых указанным файлом, делает несколько копий на одном картридже, находит сбойные секторы, пытается восстановить поврежденные файлы, переименовывает файлы и многое другое. Особенно удобной для меня оказалась возможность вывести на экран или бумагу ASCII-содержимое поврежденного файла, который отказывался открываться в моем текстовом процессоре.

Вся прелесть M/DRIVE DOCTOR для такого пользователя, как я, заключается в том, что (за исключением довольно сложного редактора секторов) она невероятно проста в обращении. Вся утилита, записанная несколько раз подряд на одном картридже, загружается практически мгновенно. В большинстве случаев достаточно просто ввести команды вроде `* CAT`, `* LLIST`, `* READ`, `* CHAR$` или `* RESTORE`. Например, команда `* MOVE` переносит всё с одного картриджа на другой (при наличии двух приводов).

M/DRIVE DOCTOR не следует путать с программой M-DOC от Seven Stars Publishing (34 Squirrel Rise, Marlow, Bucks.), которые также создали прекрасные утилиты печати QUALITAS для Tasword 2 и Tasword 3. M-DOC предназначена для ремонта и редактирования сбойных секторов и файлов, включая Бейсик. Насколько я понимаю, она требует немало терпения. Один из рецензентов написал: «эта программа не для тех, кто нетерпелив», так что для меня она точно не подходит! Тем не менее, зная другие программы от Seven Stars и их готовность помочь, я уверен, что многим владельцам микродрайвов она пригодится.

RAMDOS MICRODRIVE MANAGEMENT AND RECOVERY SOFTWARE от Roybot (45 Hullbridge Road, Rayleigh, Essex) по своим возможностям во многом похожа на M/DRIVE DOCTOR, но устроена совершенно иначе. Она работает через систему меню, и мне показалась чуть более сложной: приходится менять картриджи местами и разбираться, какой пункт меню сейчас нужен. Впрочем, к ней прилагается подробное, вполне понятное и хорошо оформленное руководство. Освоить ее несложно, и я бы пользовался ей чаще, если бы у меня не было надежной M/DRIVE DOCTOR. Из интересных дополнительных возможностей: сохранение файлов или сброс целых картриджей на ленту (например, номеров OUTLET), хотя загружать их обратно приходится тоже через RAMDOS; а также функция пометки подозрительных секторов картриджа как «занятых» (busy), чтобы они не использовались, повышая тем самым надежность картриджа. Программа дает исчерпывающую информацию о состоянии картриджей и файлов. Roybot выпускает и другие интересные программы, включая MICRODRIVE OPERATING SYSTEM.

Фирма Transform (24 West Oak, Beckenham, Kent) предлагает программу SUPADRIVE, которая форматирует картриджи примерно до 100 КБ, восстанавливает испорченные файлы и печатает полный каталог.

Моим недавним и, пожалуй, самым полезным приобретением стал пакет MICROMATE от LERM (11 Beaconsfield Close, Whitley Bay). Это наиболее всеобъемлющий пакет, сочетающий в себе достоинства многих перечисленных выше программ. Помимо картриджа, в комплект входит кассета с резервными копиями части утилит и программой «RUN» — простейшим загрузчиком по одной клавише, но только для Бейсик-программ (к которым, конечно, относятся и программы в машинных кодах с Бейсик-загрузчиком). К пакету прилагается чрезвычайно подробная инструкция, в которой помимо руководства пользователя есть масса технической информации об устройстве и принципах работы Microdrive, что наверняка заинтересует многих подписчиков OUTLET.

MICROMATE управляется через меню и содержит:

1. **FULL CAT** — выдает детальную информацию, включая занятые секторы, умеет сохранять данные для печати, менять строки автозапуска и удалять файлы.
2. **TOOLKIT** — инструмент для восстановления картриджей, починки секторов, изоляции сбойных участков и массового стирания. То, как подробно состояние картриджа отображается на экране, впечатляет и по-настоящему интригует. Я даже почти с нетерпением жду ошибки «File not found», чтобы опробовать ее в деле.
3. **BACKUP** — для одного или двух приводов: копирует файлы, клонирует картриджи, переименовывает файлы, проверяет ошибки и т.д. В программе предусмотрен великолепный режим форматирования с выбором из 10 различных настроек емкости: от ~85 КБ до 104 КБ. (Повышенная емкость снижает надежность, но на практике картриджи на 100 КБ от M/DRIVE DOCTOR меня ни разу не подводили).
4. **TAPER** — уже показал себя невероятно полезным. Он копирует файлы с картриджа на ленту как вручную, так и в автоматическом режиме при непрерывно включенном магнитофоне. Последний способ неэкономно расходует пленку, зато бережет уйму времени и нервов! Можно сбросить картридж целиком или предварительно выбрать файлы, причем в отличие от RAMDOS файлы с ленты читаются стандартными средствами, без участия MICROMATE. Теперь я скидываю номера OUTLET на ленту, предварительно удалив ненужные файлы, и освобождаю ценные картриджи для следующих выпусков журнала, делая покупку еще выгоднее!
5. **MINITAPE 8** — копирует с ленты на картридж, за исключением защищенных программ.

Удобство работы? До сих пор MICROMATE казался мне очень простым благодаря подсказкам на экране. Руководство поначалу может напугать объемом, но в нем четко указано, что обязательно к прочтению, а что факультативно. Я был приятно удивлен тем, насколько легко мне дались все опробованные функции. После пары ошибок на старте всё работает отлично.

IMBOS от Companion (193 Brampton Road, Carlisle, Cumbria) — это нечто совсем иное. *(Версия 2 программы IMBOS уже вышла у Kobrahsoft, и мы заказали копию на обзор — Брайан)*. В ней действительно есть 10 команд управления микродрайвом, позволяющих загружать, сохранять и удалять программы простыми командами вроде `RUN "name"`, `OUT! "name"`, `* ERASE "name"` (хотя более единообразный синтаксис был бы удобнее). Команда `LIST CAT` выдает каталог, в котором отмечены и показаны все защищенные файлы (например, содержащие `CHR$ 0`). Однако IMBOS — это гораздо большее. Она скорее относится к третьей категории (помощники программиста), поскольку включает огромное количество команд для вывода впечатляющего звука, графики, цвета, шрифтов, скроллинга, мониторинга памяти и других эффектов. Сам я программированием не занимаюсь, поэтому не понимаю и почти не использую большую часть пакета (кое-что напоминает мне SUPERCODE III), но эффекты там впечатляющие — к программе прилагается 10-минутное демо. В ней масса всего, что могло бы мне пригодиться, сумей я в этом разобраться. Книга написана для людей гораздо более сведущих, чем я. Отзывы в прессе были восторженными, и, судя по письмам читателей OUTLET по поводу различных алгоритмов, IMBOS пришлась бы им по вкусу — возможно, со временем кто-то из них поделится секретами. На самом деле IMBOS использует ресурсы Interface 1, но может работать и вовсе без приводов. Companion также продает EX-BASIC — расширенную версию, которой Interface 1 не требуется.

Итак, что же я порекомендую? Разумеется, всё зависит от ваших задач. Все эти программы полезны, особенно, полагаю, для тех, у кого, как и у меня, мало знаний, времени и терпения. Цены варьируются от семи до пятнадцати фунтов (CATLOADER еще дешевле), так что все они стоят своих денег, особенно те, что увеличивают емкость картриджа. Будь M/DRIVE DOCTOR до сих пор в продаже, он занимал бы в моем рейтинге высшие строчки благодаря предельной простоте. Но если бы мне пришлось выбрать только ОДНУ программу, сегодня я однозначно выбрал бы MICROMATE от LERM.

*— Крис Клейтон*
